title: Object - Stakeholder Relationship Change Event
description: Object describing a change event for the relationship(s) between the stakeholder and the issuer

comments.description: Unstructured text comments related to and stored for the object

date.description: Date on which the transaction occurred

stakeholder_id.description: Identifier of the Stakeholder object, a subject of this change event "transaction"

relationship_started.description: Denoting the beginning of this relationship on the change date

relationship_ended.description: Denoting the ending of this relationship on the change date
